  如園 to 鑑園 is only a few steps. Water runs all round, and the terraces are seen in it as in a mirror.

  > 临泉搴荔帏，迸水上苔矶。净响真宜耳，寒光欲湿衣。鱼恬心不跃，鸟惜影忘飞。王济曾何谓，于斯辨是非。

  > 复降寻崖际，水斋坐潄琼。何来金石响，绝胜管弦声。不舍科盈进，有源渠自成。底须三百丈，一例涤尘情。
  Poem 漱琼斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1762, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

  > 澄观是空还是色，静聆非竹亦非丝。鸣球即在溪堂侧，戛击何须更藉夔。

- **E0328** (poem, sure): 师善堂. 乾隆三十三年 (1768) · v4 p.108, under 鉴园; source ref 9-409 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=111
  > 溪水面前横，堂廉日俯清。万殊参一本，物理即人情。有照原无意，常流故不盈。会心额师善，陈戒缅阿衡。
  Poem 师善堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 鉴园.
- **E0329** (poem, sure): 题师善堂. 乾隆三十三年 (1768) · v4 p.108, under 鉴园; source ref 9-422 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=111
  > 力学在择师，宜师莫如善。为之著周誓，积斯训羲典。于从毋畏难，其乐固弗浅。彰里吾应祗，转圜吾应勉。顾名思义多，讵曰兹游衍。
  Poem 题师善堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 鉴园.
- **E0313** (poem, sure): 鉴园: 乾隆三十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor. 乾隆三十八年 (1773), date from the compilation · p.293 item (1), under 鉴园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=293

  Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 鉴园, 1773. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0330** (poem, sure): 师善堂. 乾隆四十年 (1775) · v4 p.113, under 鉴园; source ref 12-669 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=116
  > 书云主善为，易曰元善长。人有能不能，凡善皆宜仿。取诸人为善，重华堪景仰。要复在克己，德量乃能广。五言识所存，协一勉毋两。
  Poem 师善堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 鉴园.
- **E0315** (poem, sure): 鉴园. 乾隆四十一年 (1776) · v4 p.113, under 鉴园; source ref 12-829 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=116
  > 如园至鉴园，盖弗劳数武。因各据殊胜，异名称其所。是处水周遭，楼台镜中睹。无尘清净界，有象琉璃宇。偶忆文皇言，不觉意为怃。

- **E0316** (poem, sure): 鉴园: 乾隆四十一年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor. 乾隆四十一年 (1776), date from the compilation · p.293 item (2), under 鉴园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=293
  > 如园至鉴园，葢弗劳数武。因各据殊胜，异名称其所。是处水周遭，楼台镜中覩。无尘清净界，有象琉璃宇。偶忆文皇言，不觉意为怃。

- **E0317** (poem, sure): 鉴园: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation · p.293 item (3), under 鉴园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=293
  > 鉴水灵台净，光明方寸中。观澜诚有术，知止自能通。印月烛圆镜，披云见太空。勤修须内照，三省验吾躬。
  Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 鉴园, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0318** (poem, sure): 鉴园. 嘉庆三年 (1798) · v4 p.117, under 鉴园; source ref 1-342 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=120
  > 鉴物先鉴我，内省克己功。寸田养宥密，机发千里同。韬光细磨炼，精采蕴乎中。惟明视斯远，主敬听则聪。屋漏苟不愧，外诱鲜蔽蒙。其本在好问，纳诲务虚衷。妍媸彼自照，洞彻存大公。
  Poem 鉴园 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 鉴园.
- **E0319** (poem, sure): 鉴园: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation · p.293 item (4), under 鉴园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=293
  > 鉴物先鉴我，内省克已功。寸田养宥密，机发千里同。韬光细磨炼，精采蕴乎中。惟明视斯远，主敬听则聪。屋漏苟不愧，外诱鲜蔽蒙。其本在好问，纳诲务虚衷。妍媸彼自照，洞彻存大公。
  Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 鉴园, 1798, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0320** (poem, sure): 鉴园: 嘉庆十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆十五年 (1810), date from the compilation · p.293 item (5), under 鉴园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=293
  > 旧园未拈咏，修葺新品题。长春极东境，虚廊面清溪。波光印林影，漪澜接碧堤。西山滴飞翠，秀峙星汉齐。众妙聚一室，纳景水殿低。澄心鉴物理，静默寻端倪。
  Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 鉴园, 1810, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0321** (poem, sure): 鉴园: 嘉庆十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆十五年 (1810), date from the compilation · p.293 item (6), under 鉴园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=293
  > 芳墅涵长空，朗鉴印清景。林虚云有光，水远波无影。皎旭辉楼台，金碧耀藻井。泬寥万里澄，群笏排西岭。槛前列翠屏，延赏游目骋。胜概本人成，高爽卷阿境。
  Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 鉴园, 1810, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.
- **E0322** (poem, sure): 鉴园: 嘉庆十六年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor. 嘉庆十六年 (1811), date from the compilation · p.293 item (7), under 鉴园 · S360. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202007/P020200730387572832602.pdf#page=293
  > 园额义深远，鉴古始治今。艰哉御六合，恭已勉君临。哲后事迹列，择取矢寸忱。辨别圣狂念，殊途养素心。存仁斯达道，立纲欲不侵。本原守勿失，册府时探寻。
  Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 鉴园, 1811, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

  Seven short visits, 1773-1811, on water views; nothing on the form of its halls. 鉴园: 7 dated items, 1773-1811, of which 7 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1773, last dated 1811.
- **E0324** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 鉴园. 2020 edition · v4 p.107 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=110
  Of 1767, after 趣园 at Yangzhou, on the long lake north-east of 如园. A five-bay open hall faces west; 开益轩 and five-bay 漱琼斋 lie north, 师善堂 east, 芳晖楼 and 绿净榭 south, with a large boat dock behind.
- **E0165** (description, sure, search index only): 海岳开襟; 映清斋; 蒨园; 鉴园; 狮子林 (search-index text). n.d. · mhymy dasl 2278, tag 361, others · S340. https://www.mhymy.com/dasl/2278.html
  海岳开襟: lake islet about 90 m across, about 1,000 m2 of buildings, by 1747, repaired 1778 and 1791; a totem park stood here 1995-2007. 映清斋: added 1766 as a new palace of 玉玲珑馆. 蒨园: 6,600 m2, 2,300 m2 of buildings, 1752. 鉴园: repaired 1810. 狮子林: west part with 丛芳榭 by 1747, the east in imitation of Suzhou finished 1772.
